verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires the front page to show the rating reason and primary weaknesses so the result is immediately understandable.
First concrete failure: the client observed that the implemented explanation panel was too text-heavy and insufficiently scannable.
The client explicitly changes the front-page explanation to concise, easy-to-scan bullets while allowing longer detail elsewhere.
The broad claim that the design was updated per instructions does not specifically identify implementation of the front-page explanation refinement.
